name: structure-core
description: Stack-agnostic project governance for Claude Code. Enforces a four-document contract (CODINGSTYLE.md, DESIGN.md, LOG.md, docs/adr/), gates package installs and breaking changes behind Architecture Decision Records, detects the repository toolchain to run the right format/lint/typecheck/test commands, translates Figma CSS into the project's styling system, and holds implementations to no-hardcoding and algorithmic-quality standards.
